name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
extra_bullets: Wrote plain-language guidelines for consent screens with the legal team, which brought support tickets about consent wording down from about 30 a month to 5
Presented research findings to client leadership at the end of each project and turned their feedback into a prioritized list for the next phase
Made a short field guide for testing signs at bus stops that the agency used again the following summer
cover_letter_paragraph: Outside of my main projects, I keep a small habit of sitting in on support calls once a month. Hearing people describe where they got stuck in their own words has changed more of my designs than any dashboard. I would like to keep doing that with your patients and the support team that hears from them every day.

extra_reference.name: Marcus Lee
extra_reference.relationship: Product partner on the intake redesign
